subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Which signed-thinking replay policy should OpenClaw adopt for the remaining Anthropic failures: the scoped completed-turn fix plus terminal-result recovery, or a broader sanitizer/default change?
rationale: The remaining work changes provider replay semantics and prompt-cache behavior, so automation should not choose how broadly to strip signed thinking without maintainer intent.

options.title: Review the scoped fix set
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 for completed-turn prevention and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94649 for terminal-result recovery, keeping broader sanitizer/config changes out unless those prove insufficient.

options.title: Adopt a broader sanitizer
options.body: Choose a wider non-latest thinking strip policy such as https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/100149 after resolving compatibility and active-turn safety questions.

options.title: Keep umbrella triage open
options.body: Leave this issue as the canonical tracker until the open prevention and recovery branches converge or one narrower issue becomes the clear canonical path.

recommendation.title: Review the scoped fix set
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/99383 for completed-turn prevention and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94649 for terminal-result recovery, keeping broader sanitizer/config changes out unless those prove insufficient.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent adjacent Anthropic recovery/provider history makes this the best available routing owner for the replay-semantics choice.
